{{< irish childhood >}}

These pages show how many children live in Ireland, how healthy they are, and how many are in the care of the State. Child poverty is covered in the [Poverty and inequality](../poverty/child-poverty.qmd) topic, births and fertility in [Population](../population/births-deaths-marriages.qmd), schools in [Education](../education/index.qmd), and childcare and family leave in [Childcare and family leave](../childcare/index.qmd).
